scope: Every recorded capture that carries the orchard's placement: whether the tool point, the jaw mouth, the wrist camera or any robot link hull is beneath the orchard's ground relief, frame by frame. Offline geometry; the relief is visual only in the simulator.

definitions.beneath: a vertical ray from the point meets the ground above it and none below it

classes.above: nothing beneath the ground in any frame
classes.tool: the tool point, the jaw mouth or the wrist camera beneath the ground in some frame
classes.links_only: only robot link hulls beneath the ground in some frame
